title: Web player in a Link session: clock lines to the worklet, render at session tempo, start/stop, re-align
description:
## Intent
The player follows the session: clock lines into the worklet, arranging at the session's tempo, start and stop from the session. Makes apricitus-1ba752 green and the re-align scenarios of apricitus-0afc13.

## Steps
1. `web/src/audio/engine-worklet.ts`: a `clock` message calling `rw_engine_follow` (M1's export); `free-run` calling `rw_engine_free_run`; status adds the clock tempo and waiting state.
2. `web/src/audio/player.ts`: a Link mode using `link-clock.ts`; `arrange` renders at the session's tempo (override the timeline's tempo before posting to `render-worker.ts`); session start/stop drives play/pause; re-align at the next bar line after a loss or a suspended context; turning Link off keeps playing free at the last tempo.
3. The `Transport` interface gains what the UI will need: linked state, peers, session tempo, waiting, lost.
4. Extend `web/test/wasm.test.mjs` for the audible checks.

## Verify
`node web/test/wasm.test.mjs`, `cd web && npx tsx --test test/link-clock.test.ts`, `npm --prefix web run build`.

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): the web player in a Link session`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
